summary.headline: Patel Engineering Q1 FY27 consolidated PAT rose 24.5% to Rs 93.5 crore on revenue up about 4% to Rs 1,281 crore; FY27 revenue growth guided at about 10%.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue rose about 4% YoY to Rs 1,281 crore, while PAT grew 24.5% to Rs 93.5 crore, helped mainly by lower finance costs (down about Rs 10 crore YoY on lower debt). Operating EBITDA margin improved to 14.02% from 13.4%, which management attributed mainly to project mix. Order book stood at Rs 14,636 crore, with about Rs 9,000 crore of bids under evaluation and a Rs 60,000 crore near-term pipeline. Management guided to about 10% revenue growth in FY27, with most of it in the second half, and said it expects no exceptional items this year.

segments.name: Hydropower
segments.commentary: 68% of Q1 revenue and 62% of order book. Subansiri Lower has 4 of 8 units operational (1,000 MW); Unit-7 concreting started; Kwar dam concreting above 50%.

segments.name: Irrigation
segments.commentary: 15% of Q1 revenue and 17% of order book. Sleemanabad tunnel (11.95 km, MP) TBM breakthrough completed, to irrigate about 2.4 lakh hectares.

segments.name: Tunneling
segments.commentary: 13% of Q1 revenue and 4% of order book. Management expects long-run tunneling mix near 10% of revenue.

segments.name: Roads, Urban Infrastructure and others
segments.commentary: 4% of Q1 revenue and about 17% of order book (balance of order book).

guidance_outlook: FY27 consolidated revenue growth of about 10%, with a significant portion in H2 FY27; management cited 15% growth in the following year.
EBITDA margin to be maintained at about 13-14%; management does not see material margin expansion toward 15% given rising competition.
Finance costs expected to stay at reduced levels; PAT growth of about 10% expected for the current year.
Target new order inflow of about Rs 8,000 crore in FY27.
Non-core asset monetization target of Rs 150-200 crore in FY27; Rs 27 crore Telangana land sale completed in Q1.
All eight Subansiri units expected to be operational in FY27.
Patel Smondo OC expected in FY27 after litigation closure; no exceptional items expected in FY27.
capex_capacity: Subansiri Lower: 4 of 8 units operational (1,000 MW); Unit-7 concreting commenced; all eight units targeted in FY27.
Kiru and Kwar HEP (J&K): Kwar dam concreting above 50%; draft tube Unit-1 handed over to E&M agency; Parnai HEP powerhouse roof truss erected.
Dorjilung Hydropower (Bhutan): work commenced in Q1, with potential participation in larger packages.
Working capital needs for execution expected to be met mainly by client advances against bank guarantees or surety bonds, plus possible Rs 100-200 crore of working capital borrowing.
Retention money on balance sheet about Rs 200-250 crore (about 5% of each contract), mostly released at project end.
demand_pricing: Order book 14,636 crore; management expects book-to-bill of about 3x and execution over about 3 years.
Bids under evaluation about Rs 9,000 crore, mostly Arunachal and North-East hydro; near-term pipeline about Rs 60,000 crore. Outcomes of bids hoped by Diwali (per management, tentative).

Upcoming hydro opportunities cited: Kalai-II (1,200 MW, about Rs 14,000 crore), Kamla (1,720 MW, about Rs 26,000 crore), Naying (1,000 MW, environment clearance recommended), Velimalai pumped storage (1,100 MW, cleared). Sawalkote, Kalai-II and Kamla bidding not yet opened; Upper Karnali, Upper Subansiri, Kirthai and Etalin expected this year subject to clearances.
Tunneling: Fotu La tunnel (Rs 1,198 crore) cleared; Mumbai-Pune second expressway DPR (about Rs 15,000 crore) under preparation.
Competition has increased, and management said margins may not expand much; a large project went down last year.
